shared_elements: schematic anthropomorphic figure(s) in low relief
bilaterally symmetric composition on a tall vertical field
curvilinear linear ornament with dotted/beaded lines
fan or radiating-line motif at the lower end
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic low-relief curvilinear motifs on a tall vertical, bilaterally symmetric field, sharing paired crescents, ring/disc elements, a belt-like transverse band low down and small schematic anthropomorphic forms near the top, plus a radiating fan motif at the base — a moderately specific combination. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by one large frontal full-body figure with rayed head, arms, splayed hands and legs occupying the whole panel, while B has no such dominant body, only dispersed abstract rings, arcs and tiny figures over a blank mass.
